page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.r7.16xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 64 dedicated physical cores with 1 thread per core, utilizing Intel Xeon 8369B processors operating at a base frequency of 2.7 GHz. The instance is equipped with 512.0 GB of system memory, yielding a memory-to-vCPU ratio of 8.0 GB per core.

This server configuration does not include local NVMe SSD storage or integrated GPU hardware, meaning all storage requirements must be met via network-attached block storage. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 32 Gbps. There are no complimentary public IPv4 addresses bundled with the instance.

The high memory density relative to the processing cores positions this instance class as a resource-efficient option for workloads requiring large in-memory datasets without the overhead of excessive compute scaling. It is designed for memory-intensive applications, including in-memory databases, large-scale caching layers, enterprise resource planning systems, and memory-bound data processing pipelines.
